description: This test file verifies that callback lists in the litellm framework are not modified directly except through designated classes. It scans Python source files to detect forbidden modifications to specific callback lists, helping ensure encapsulation and integrity of callback management. It includes functions to parse files, check for unauthorized list modifications, and run the scan across the project directory.

methods.name: check_for_callback_modifications(file_path)
methods.description: Reads a Python file and uses AST parsing to detect any direct modifications to protected callback lists outside of allowed classes, returning violation messages if found.

methods.name: scan_directory_for_callback_modifications(base_dir)
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for Python files and applies the callback modification check, aggregating any violations.

methods.name: test_no_unauthorized_callback_modifications()
methods.description: Runs the full scan and asserts that no unauthorized callback list modifications exist in the codebase, otherwise raises an assertion error.

ctags.name: warning_msg
ctags.pattern: /^warning_msg = "this is a serious violation. Callbacks must only be modified through LoggingCallb/

fields.name: warning_msg = "this is a serious violation. Callbacks must only be modified through LoggingCallb/
